noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

endpoint.description: Endpoint path for which the WebSocket handler should listen (e.g., /websocket, /stream)

idleTimeout.description: Idle timeout in milliseconds after which the connection will be closed (default: 60 seconds)

enableLogging.description: Whether to enable logging for this WebSocket endpoint

closeOnError.description: If set, closes the WebSocket connection when an error occurs during message processing

customHeaders.description: Custom headers to include in WebSocket handshake response

title:
The @webSocket annotation is used for specifying properties for WebSocket handlers.
This annotation provides the most commonly needed configuration options for WebSocket endpoints.
name: Ann.WebSocket
